summary: Training walkthrough (video 13.0 Commitments, 01:01) of the Seller Performance > Commitments tab. The trainer explains that a seller can offer a fixed price and quantity per device for the commitment window 20 Oct 2026 to 10 Nov 2026, with submissions closing Thu 22 Oct 2026 at 6 PM UAE time. He types a price and quantity on two devices, shows the optional colour split and its error state, saves the offer, and notes that saved versions are kept and accepted commitments are locked in the buybox. All 15 frames in the pack were opened. The first frame is black. Several facts are time-sensitive: the recording countdown shows 7d 02:10:57 with a saved stamp of 15 Oct, while the session date is 22 Oct 2026, the deadline day.

terms.meaning: An offer to supply a quantity of a device at a fixed price for the whole window (screen wording).
The period the fixed price applies to: 20 Oct 2026 to 10 Nov 2026.
The deadline for offers: Thu 22 Oct 2026, 6 PM UAE time. The countdown on screen shows the time left.
The price and quantity Revibe proposes for each device. The seller can offer different values.
The seller's own offer values for a device. Prices are in AED.
Row link that the trainer names as an alternative to typing your own price and quantity. The screen does not show what it fills in.
Optional breakdown of a device's quantity into colour rows, each with a SKU. If used, the colour quantities must add up to the device quantity.
Buybox is the place where accepted commitments are locked at the seller's price (slide wording). Buybox open is a status pill on the seller page. The screen does not define the term further.
History of saved offer versions; every saved version is kept.
The time zone of the submission deadline (Thu 22 Oct 2026, 18:00).

unclear.issue: The opening word {Lock?} is low confidence and no frame shows the word lock. The black first frame has no visible content for 00:00 to 00:07. This line is not relied on as a fact; the window dates are confirmed by the frame at 00:07.

The Saudi Arabia table is named in the narration and in a tooltip, but no frame shows it. Its devices, suggested values and currency are not visible. The on-screen bullets say prices are in AED for the page generally, but the Saudi table is not shown.
The trainer says so you can buy stock in advance with confidence, but does not say whether you means Revibe or the seller. Only the quoted wording is recorded.

While iphone-12 showed the colour error, the bottom bar read 1 device, 225 units, AED 194,625 with 1 line to fix. That total matches iphone-14 alone (225 units), while iphone-12 had 200 units entered. The screen does not say whether a line with an error is left out of the offer total or of the saved offer.
